source_record.defect: Citing Proposition compact-is-perfect, the proof says perfect objects are compact objects of D(O_X). That proposition proves compactness in D_QCoh(O_X), which is the ambient category relevant here; the stronger full D(O_X) claim is neither the cited statement nor generally justified by this step.

evidence.observation: The cited proposition is explicitly about objects of D_QCoh(O_X).
The proof needs only compactness in D_QCoh(O_X), then in its direct-sum-closed supported subcategory.

source_record.smallest_proposed_correction: Replace 'compact objects of D(O_X)' with 'compact objects of D_QCoh(O_X)'.
source_record.translation_impact: The Japanese target preserves the frozen D(O_X) category at this locus and records the category correction only here.
